verdict.rationale: CrewAI is a framework and platform for building your own agents, and its docs cover agents delegating tasks to each other within user-built crews. Nothing in the evidence describes a built-in, first-party AI assistant inside CrewAI or AMP/Crew Studio that users can hand tasks to: Crew Studio is described only as a no-code/low-code builder, and the coding-agent setup prompt targets external tools like Claude Code or Cursor. A platform with a UI could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence of one.
